name: Sar Auto Products Limited
about: Sar Auto Products Limited manufactures and sells auto components in India. It offers synchronizer rings, cones, sleeves, and hubs; transmission gears and housings for automative, agricultural, and engineering applications and spur, helical, straight bevel gear, and sprockets, as well as transmission spline shafts, couplings, power take-off clutches used for transmission, engine, and differential gear boxes. The company also engages in real estate development activities. Sar Auto Products Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Rajkot, India.
